elements.todo-input: text input for a new todo
elements.todo-add: button that adds the typed todo
elements.todo-list: ul containing one li per todo
elements.todo-item: li for one todo; data-id attribute is the todo id

behaviours.add: typing text and clicking todo-add appends an li to todo-list with that text; the input clears
behaviours.toggle: clicking todo-toggle on an item flips its done state; the item gets class 'done'
behaviours.delete: clicking todo-delete removes exactly that li from todo-list
behaviours.filter: filter-all/active/done show only matching items; the active filter button gets class 'active'
behaviours.stats: stats-total/active/done always show the integer counts of all/not-done/done items
behaviours.persist: the todo list survives a page reload (localStorage)
